scribes-and-pharisees.name: The scribes and Pharisees
scribes-and-pharisees.note: Accusers of the woman, tempting Jesus.

jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.note: The Lord; teaching with authority, calm and grave.

pharisees.name: The Pharisees
pharisees.note: Pharisees of the council; scornful, accusing.

the-jews.name: The Jews
the-jews.note: The Jewish authorities and opponents in Jerusalem and Capharnaum; challenging, hostile.

1.t: And Jesus went unto mount Olivet.

2.t: And early in the morning he came again into the temple: and all the people came to him. And sitting down he taught them.

3.t: And the scribes and Pharisees bring unto him a woman taken in adultery: and they set her in the midst,

4.t: Master, this woman was even now taken in adultery.

5.t: Now Moses in the law commanded us to stone such a one. But what sayest thou?

6.t: And this they said tempting him, that they might accuse him. But Jesus bowing himself down, wrote with his finger on the ground.

7.t: When therefore they continued asking him, he lifted up himself and said to them:
He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

8.t: And again stooping down, he wrote on the ground.

9.t: But they hearing this, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest. And Jesus alone remained, and the woman standing in the midst.

10.t: Then Jesus lifting up himself, said to her:
Woman, where are they that accused thee? Hath no man condemned thee?

11.t: Neither will I condemn thee. Go, and now sin no more.

12.t: Again therefore, Jesus spoke to: them, saying:
I am the light of the world. He that followeth me walketh not in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

13.t: The Pharisees therefore said to him:
Thou givest testimony of thyself. Thy testimony is not true.

14.t: Jesus answered and said to them:
Although I give testimony of myself, my testimony is true: for I know whence I came and whither I go.

15.t: You judge according to the flesh: I judge not any man.

16.t: And if I do judge, my judgment is true: because I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

17.t: And in your law it is written that the testimony of two men is true.

18.t: I am one that give testimony of myself: and the Father that sent me giveth testimony of me.

19.t: Neither me do you know, nor my Father. If you did know me, perhaps you would know my Father also.

20.t: These words Jesus spoke in the treasury, teaching in the temple: and no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

21.t: Again therefore Jesus said to them:
I go: and you shall seek me. And you shall die in your sin. Whither I go, you cannot come.

22.t: Will he kill himself, because he said: Whither I go you cannot come?

23.t: You are from beneath: I am from above. You are of this world: I am not of this world.

24.t: Therefore I said to you that you shall die in your sins. For if you believe not that I am he, you shall die in your sin.

25.t: The beginning, who also speak unto you.

26.t: Many things I have to speak and to judge of you. But he that sent me, is true: and the things I have heard of him, these same I speak in the world.

27.t: And they understood not that he called God his Father.

28.t: When you shall have lifted up, the Son of man, then shall you know that I am he and that I do nothing of myself. But as the Father hath taught me, these things I speak.

29.t: And he that sent me is with me: and he hath not left me alone. For I do always the things that please him.

30.t: When he spoke these things, many believed in him.

31.t: Then Jesus said to those Jews who believed him:
If you continue in my word, you shall be my disciples indeed.

32.t: And you shall know the truth: and the truth shall make you free.

33.t: We are the seed of Abraham: and we have never been slaves to any man. How sayest thou: You shall be free?

34.t: Amen, amen, I say unto you that whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

35.t: Now the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the son abideth for ever.

36.t: If therefore the son shall make you free, you shall be free indeed.

37.t: I know that you are the children of Abraham: but you seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

38.t: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and you do the things that you have seen with your father.

39.t: They answered and said to him:
If you be the children of Abraham, do the works of Abraham.

40.t: But now you seek to kill me, a man who have spoken the truth to you, which I have heard of God. This Abraham did not.

41.t: You do the works of your father.
We are not born of fornication: we have one Father, even God.

42.t: If God were your Father, you would indeed love me. For from God I proceeded and came. For I came not of myself: but he sent me.

43.t: Why do you not know my speech? Because you cannot hear my word.

44.t: You are of your father the devil: and the desires of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning: and he stood not in the truth, because truth is not in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father thereof.

45.t: But if I say the truth, you believe me not.

46.t: Which of you shall convince me of sin? If I say the truth to you, why do you not believe me:

47.t: He that is of God heareth the words of God. Therefore you hear them not, because you are not of God.

48.t: The Jews therefore answered and said to him:
Do not we say well that thou art a Samaritan and hast a devil?

49.t: I have not a devil: but I honour my Father. And you have dishonoured me.

50.t: But I seek not my own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

51.t: Amen, amen, I say to you: If any man keep my word, he shall not see death for ever.

52.t: Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets: and thou sayest: If any man keep my word, he shall not taste death for ever.

53.t: Art thou greater than our father Abraham who is dead? And the prophets are dead. Whom dost thou make thyself?

54.t: If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father that glorifieth me, of whom you say that he is your God.

55.t: And you have not known him: but I know him. And if I shall say that I know him not, I shall be like to you, a liar. But I do know him and do keep his word.

56.t: Abraham your father rejoiced that he might see my day: he saw it and was glad.

57.t: The Jews therefore said to him:
Thou art not yet fifty years old. And hast thou seen Abraham?

58.t: Amen, amen, I say to you, before Abraham was made, I AM.

59.t: They took up stones therefore to cast at him. But Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple.
